annotations.title: Find art for sale from independent artists

description: Find art for sale from independent artists. Searches works in independent artists' own shops and eBay art by words (subject, style, place, artist), kind, original or print, price, size and colour. Results show title, artist, size, price, where it ships from, an image and a link to buy straight from the artist.

colour.description: A main colour, for example blue or ochre.

country.description: Buyer's two-letter country code, for eBay and currency, for example US or GB.

currency.description: Currency for prices, for example USD, GBP or EUR.

kind.description: Kind: painting, print, printmaking, photography, drawing, watercolour, ceramics, sculpture, textile, illustration or other.

max_price.description: Highest price, in the currency given (or the buyer's local currency).

original.description: Set to true for one-off originals only, false for prints only.

q.description: What to look for, for example abstract blue, linocut bird, Scottish landscape or a dog portrait.

ships_from.description: Only artists based in this two-letter country.

unit.description: Unit: in or cm. Defaults to in.
